title: Recovery, a single in Phoenix and the Flaming Youth Revue
summary: After typhoid he plays a single in Phoenix, then goes on the circuit with the Flaming Youth Revue.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Yeah -- hold on a minute, Red. Well, I digressed a little bit there -- but you said you went in the theater and you heard Al and Bing --
-- for the first time and it knocked you out. Ah -- well to go back to you at that point, now, you were just recuperating from typhoid --

Yeah, that's right. Then I finally got well enough and the agent booked me for a couple of dates and that's when I went to -- went to Phoenix, I did a single there. First time I'd ever tried that. My brother was living in Phoenix, the oldest boy, Howard was living in Phoenix there and he was married and had two boys, and that's the first inclination that I ever -- he was -- kind of liked the thing --
So then I went on back to Chicago --
Well Red would you say that you were really on a vaudeville circuit there?

Oh, yeah, I was on the circuit, all that time, up till the the time -- I even -- that following year -- oh, that same year, I -- I went out there again with -- with a guy -- act called the Flaming Youth Review. Which was -- a girl that was very small, that graduated from Ohio State that did a drunk number and did a kid number and another kid that we danced together --
How did you know how to dance together?
Hang around the theater, you learn, you pick up, everybody tries those sort of things. But I used to

I used to drive everybody crazy around that theater because I had a record machine, I was always playing jazz records on it, everybody used to go crazy. "Turn that thing off", they'd yell. I'd be playing these records, the jazz band going that thing --
